Bank charges, GCT, interest and withholding tax: a journal entry made from a statement line already fills in the account you chose last time. With classes switched on, it now fills in the class you chose last time too.
A bank rule’s own account and class still come first. The bank line gets no class, and a class made inactive in QuickBooks is not filled in.
This also applies to A journal entry for each… in the Reconcile help
